chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Ali ibn Abi Hamza, from Abu Baseer, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
When you scratch your head, scratch gently, and do not scratch with the nails, but with the tips of the fingers.
ai.seo_question: How should one scratch their head according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi details the specific etiquette for relieving an itch during Ihram, emphasizing gentleness to avoid breaking the state of consecration through excessive action or injury. It reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on balancing physical comfort with ritual precision, ensuring that minor acts like scratching do not inadvertently nullify the pilgrimage's sanctity.
